operating_modes.CALIBRATION_M_AUX_INSERTED: M_aux and the diagonal-polarization DET10/M chain are inserted to calibrate differential 633 nm signal against the other BS2 810 nm output as a function of piezo voltage. The paper does not lock the simultaneous 633 nm minus-port transfer through or around inserted M_aux, so a closed differential loop is not asserted in this mode.
operating_modes.LOCK: 633 nm propagation upstream of the removable M_aux state; this label alone does not assert a closed differential loop.
operating_modes.LOCK_MEASUREMENT_M_AUX_REMOVED: The M_aux-removed state exposes both published 633 nm BS2 outputs to the differential detector and closes the phase loop.
operating_modes.MEASUREMENT_M_AUX_REMOVED: The removable M_aux calibration optic is out; the auxiliary 810 nm BS2 port is sent to a planned beam dump while the X/Y/herald endpoints operate.
mode_exclusivity: E801 and E803 are mutually exclusive
E733 and E735-E740 are valid only in LOCK_MEASUREMENT_M_AUX_REMOVED
simultaneous CALIBRATION_M_AUX_INSERTED plus closed differential 633 nm feedback is UNVERIFIED
